how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stonetalon-mountains-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1057:obj:0: Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
rows.quest:1057:details:0: As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.
rows.quest:1057:details:1: BYou have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.
rows.quest:1057:details:2: BThe Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.
rows.quest:1057:completion:0: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
rows.quest:1058:obj:0: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon ⟦E1⟧, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
rows.quest:1058:details:1: BThree little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!
rows.quest:1058:details:2: BI'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.
rows.quest:1058:details:3: BHurry to Stonetalon Peak, ⟦2⟧, so I can brew some forest magic!
rows.quest:1058:completion:0: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!
rows.quest:1059:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ to Falfindel Waywarder on the border of ⟦E3⟧ and ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1059:details:0: The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.
rows.quest:1059:details:1: BFar south of the ⟦E5⟧ lies a land known as ⟦E3⟧. If you travel west in ⟦E3⟧ until you reach the lush forest's edge of ⟦E4⟧, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.
rows.quest:1059:details:2: BThis great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.
rows.quest:1059:details:3: BSend word of our need! Seek him out at once!
rows.quest:1059:completion:0: Keeper Albagorm was wise to send you with such urgency.
rows.quest:1059:completion:1: BLet us see if we cannot call forth aid from the great forest to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
rows.quest:1061:obj:0: Speak with Seereth Stonebreak in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1061:details:0: The spirits of the ⟦E6⟧ are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land. So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.
rows.quest:1061:details:1: BSeereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the ⟦E7⟧, was sent to Stonetalon. She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.
rows.quest:1061:details:2: BMeet Seereth in Stonetalon. To reach her, follow the road west of the ⟦E5⟧' Crossroads. She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
rows.quest:1061:completion:0: Ah, a ⟦3⟧. Very good. We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
rows.quest:1062:obj:0: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1062:details:0: The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the ⟦E6⟧, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest. The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage. We must stop the Venture Company!
rows.quest:1062:details:1: BHead northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag. You will find the goblins and their servants at work--show them the ⟦E7⟧ will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon. Show them in the language they best understand...
rows.quest:1062:completion:1: BWe may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...
rows.quest:1062:completion:2: BRidding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
rows.quest:1063:details:0: To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.
rows.quest:1063:details:1: BI do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha. I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much. If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.
rows.quest:1063:details:2: BMagatha resides in the tauren capital of ⟦E8⟧, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff. Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1063:completion:0: I bid you greetings. You are here seeking council?
rows.quest:1068:obj:0: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the ⟦E6⟧ and the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1068:details:0: There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shaman and the natural magic of druids. This is why we shaman can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon. Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...
rows.quest:1068:details:1: BI saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed. These metal beasts must be stopped!
rows.quest:1068:details:2: BIn my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:
rows.quest:1068:completion:0: The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, ⟦5⟧. With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.
rows.quest:1068:completion:1: BFor if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
rows.quest:1071:obj:0: Kill 10 Venture Co. Loggers, and 10 Venture Co. Deforesters and return to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1071:details:0: You see, ⟦6⟧, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, ⟦E9⟧ and ⟦E10⟧ Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.
rows.quest:1071:details:1: BBut it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!
rows.quest:1071:details:2: BI need some time to plan and organize. But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
rows.quest:1071:completion:0: Thanks so much for your help, ⟦7⟧. You're actually back just in time.
rows.quest:1071:completion:1: BI think I've got the perfect plan. Explosives. No, that's not the plan, but it's part of the plan.
rows.quest:1071:completion:2: BSee, I've been using high explosives--don't worry, they're not as dangerous as everyone thinks--to scare the goblins back a bit. I can herd 'em pretty good with a few key detonations along the mountains' edges, but I've been low on supplies now for a few days.
rows.quest:1072:details:0: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.
rows.quest:1072:details:1: BAnd for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.
rows.quest:1072:details:2: BThe only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.
rows.quest:1072:details:3: BYou talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
rows.quest:1072:completion:0: Ahhh. Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm?
rows.quest:1073:obj:0: Bring 4 Minor Mana Potions and 2 Elixirs of Minor Fortitude to Lomac Gearstrip in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1073:details:0: Hahaha... you need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!
rows.quest:1073:details:1: BI don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.
rows.quest:1073:details:2: BThere's a problem though: I'm all out.
rows.quest:1073:details:3: BBut I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.
rows.quest:1073:details:4: BThe least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.
rows.quest:1073:completion:1: BIf I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
rows.quest:1074:obj:0: Bring the Nitromirglyceronium back to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1074:details:0: Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.
rows.quest:1074:details:1: BIf you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
rows.quest:1074:completion:0: Your task has been done flawlessly, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:1074:completion:1: BNG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.
rows.quest:1074:completion:2: BWhat? Yes, dynamite... wagons of it. It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... just wait and see.
rows.quest:1075:details:0: Okay, now for the remote detonation part of my plan... oh, I haven't explained that yet, have I?
rows.quest:1075:details:1: BOkay, so the short of it is this: with a little magic, I can make it so the explosives go off while you're not around. I'm putting together a device that'll allow you to push just one button and have the NG-5 explode when you're ready.
rows.quest:1075:details:2: BBut I need a spell from a friend in ⟦E12⟧--Collin Mauren is his name. You can find him in the mage quarter there. He's human, so he shouldn't be hard to miss.
rows.quest:1075:completion:0: Now, this spell you need; one that will allow you detonate explosives from a distance... hmmm.
rows.quest:1076:obj:0: Bring Dust Devil Debris to Collin Mauren in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1076:details:0: Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for.
rows.quest:1076:details:1: BI'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil.
rows.quest:1076:details:2: BWhile I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to ⟦E13⟧ and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments.
rows.quest:1076:details:3: BI'll be here when you return.
rows.quest:1076:completion:0: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
rows.quest:1077:obj:0: Bring the Scroll of Messaging to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1077:details:0: Here you are, ⟦9⟧. This should do nicely.
rows.quest:1077:details:1: BPlease give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.
rows.quest:1077:completion:1: BThis spell, mixed with the NG-5, shall make the perfect remote explosive.
rows.quest:1077:completion:2: BWe'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.
rows.quest:1077:completion:3: BThat will surely slow down their deforestation acts.
rows.quest:1078:obj:0: Bring 8 Crystalized Scales to Collin Mauren in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1078:details:0: Travelers keep asking me about the ⟦E6⟧. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.
rows.quest:1078:details:1: BWithin the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.
rows.quest:1078:details:2: BIf those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.
rows.quest:1078:details:3: BTake your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
rows.quest:1078:completion:0: This is perfect, ⟦11⟧. Thank you greatly.
rows.quest:1078:completion:1: BPerhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
rows.quest:1079:obj:0: Retrieve the Venture Co.'s ⟦E10⟧ Plans from the lumber mill in Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1079:details:0: This is it, ⟦12⟧. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.
rows.quest:1079:details:1: BTake these pages--they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.
rows.quest:1079:details:2: BRemember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.
rows.quest:1079:completion:0: Truly amazing! This is a huge blow to the Venture Co.
rows.quest:1079:completion:1: BWe'll be able to find weaknesses in their machines and also incorporate their designs into our own creations. This is a wonderful day, indeed.
rows.quest:1080:obj:0: Retrieve the Venture Co. Letters from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag.
rows.quest:1080:details:0: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:1080:details:1: BWe cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
rows.quest:1080:details:2: BThe key is to get their letters... remember that.
rows.quest:1080:details:3: BThe pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
rows.quest:1080:completion:0: Incredible, ⟦14⟧! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
rows.quest:1081:details:0: ⟦15⟧, I am sure Tyrande Whisperwind herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.
rows.quest:1081:details:1: BIt may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1081:details:2: BIf you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:1081:completion:0: Hello, ⟦16⟧. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.
rows.quest:1081:completion:1: BYou would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.
rows.quest:1082:details:0: ⟦17⟧, you have done a great deed by lending a hand here.
rows.quest:1082:details:1: BThe Sentinels of ⟦E15⟧ will reward you well if you informed them that Gaxim and I are alive. Tell them we are well on our way to stopping the Venture Co. and healing the lands.
rows.quest:1082:details:2: BFind Tara Thenysil in Astranaar; she will be pleased to see you've returned with good news.
rows.quest:1082:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦18⟧. You have done a service to the Sentinels.
rows.quest:1082:completion:1: BI'm glad to see Kaela... and even Gaxim, are doing well.
rows.quest:1083:obj:0: Bring 8 Smoldering Embers from any of the fire elementals in the Charred Vale to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1083:details:0: I'm unsure what the Venture Co. did to the Vale, but it's obvious they were overpowered by the creatures there.
rows.quest:1083:details:1: BThey set the forest aflame, and used their inventions of destruction to decimate as much of the Vale as possible.
rows.quest:1083:details:2: BBut in their ignorance they also released something else: burning spirits, elementals of flame, stone and rage.
rows.quest:1083:details:3: BThe land has no chance to see ⟦E16⟧'s smile while these creatures roam free.
rows.quest:1083:details:4: BBring me their smoldering embers to show you've reduced their numbers.
rows.quest:1083:completion:0: The remains of our enemy... your strength serves us well, ⟦19⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:1084:obj:0: Bring a piece of Corroded Shrapnel to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1084:details:0: It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale--the treants--had something to do with the Venture Co. being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.
rows.quest:1084:details:1: BGaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.
rows.quest:1084:details:2: BI told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded ⟦E17⟧ and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.
rows.quest:1084:details:3: BBring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...
rows.quest:1084:completion:1: BThis should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. I shall give this to him right away.
rows.quest:1087:obj:0: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:1087:details:0: You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.
rows.quest:1087:details:1: BWould that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.
rows.quest:1087:details:2: BI have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
rows.quest:1087:completion:0: Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.
rows.quest:1087:completion:1: BWhat a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
rows.quest:1088:obj:0: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:1088:details:0: They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!
rows.quest:1088:details:1: BMagic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in ⟦E15⟧ Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.
rows.quest:1088:details:2: BBring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
rows.quest:1088:completion:0: I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.
rows.quest:1088:completion:1: BHis head does not rise so high now, does it, ⟦21⟧?
rows.quest:1088:completion:2: BI promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.
rows.quest:1089:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.
rows.quest:1089:details:0: The druids built the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, where they keep many powerful items.
rows.quest:1089:details:1: BThey devised a complex scheme to keep them from falling into the wrong hands.
rows.quest:1089:details:2: BLuckily, I managed to... extract some details from one of them.
rows.quest:1089:details:3: BHidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, you will find the Gatekeeper's Key--with it you will be able to open caches around the Den. The items from these caches will allow you to open their hoard, located in one of the central areas.
rows.quest:1089:completion:0: As the three keys are slid into their matching openings, in the middle of the glowing light a number of items appear.
rows.quest:1090:obj:0: Get the mysterious ore from Piznik after he finishes mining it.
rows.quest:1090:details:0: You know, I was once the second most important person here at this site. That all changed when Gerenzo took over. Fired my boss, Ziz Fizziks, and sent me down to work in the mines. Ziz told me to stay here and gather information, though. His new boss will pay us well if we can find out what Gerenzo's plans are.
rows.quest:1090:details:1: BAnyways, what I do know is that Gerenzo has ordered large amounts of this gold-green ore to be mined. I can get you a sample to bring to Ziz, but you'll have to watch for patrols while I get it.
rows.quest:1090:completion:0: Thanks, ⟦22⟧. It was looking a little dicey there for a second and we've probably drawn far too much attention to ourselves.
rows.quest:1090:completion:1: BThe important part is that we have the ore sample, though, and we should get it to Ziz as soon as possible.
rows.quest:1091:obj:0: Bring the Venture Co. Letters to Kaela Shadowspear.
rows.quest:1091:details:0: ⟦23⟧, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
rows.quest:1091:details:1: BMake sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.
rows.quest:1091:completion:1: BYou and Gaxim have done very well, ⟦24⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:1092:obj:0: Deliver the Unidentified Ore to Ziz Fizziks in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1092:details:0: I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.
rows.quest:1092:details:1: BI'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!
rows.quest:1092:details:2: BI'll try and clean up this mess a little, but you should take the ore sample to Ziz right away. He told me that he'd set up camp somewhere on the western side of Windshear Crag. Good luck.
rows.quest:1092:completion:0: Ahhh, I knew that I did the right thing by telling Piznik to stay behind. I'm sure the engineers in Undermine will be most interested to look at this...
rows.quest:1092:completion:1: BOf course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?
rows.quest:1093:obj:0: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1093:details:0: Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!
rows.quest:1093:details:1: BLucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!
rows.quest:1093:details:2: BTells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
rows.quest:1093:completion:0: Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!
rows.quest:1093:completion:1: BNow, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
rows.quest:1094:obj:0: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1094:details:0: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.
rows.quest:1094:details:1: BSputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the ⟦E5⟧. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
rows.quest:1094:completion:0: Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.
rows.quest:1094:completion:1: BThey do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
rows.quest:1095:obj:0: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1095:details:0: The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.
rows.quest:1095:details:1: BRiddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.
rows.quest:1095:details:2: BWhatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
rows.quest:1095:completion:0: Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.
rows.quest:1095:completion:1: BGnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate ⟦E18⟧ well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
rows.quest:1096:obj:0: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1096:details:0: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.
rows.quest:1096:details:1: BNortheast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.
rows.quest:1096:details:2: BIf you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
rows.quest:1096:completion:0: Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!
rows.quest:1096:completion:2: BAt least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
rows.quest:5881:obj:0: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5881:details:0: The ⟦E7⟧ does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:5881:details:1: BI need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
rows.quest:5881:completion:0: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!
rows.quest:6282:obj:0: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
rows.quest:6282:details:0: Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:6282:details:1: BThe Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in ⟦E19⟧; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.
rows.quest:6282:details:2: BI need you to cull the harpies, ⟦25⟧!
rows.quest:6282:completion:0: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
rows.quest:6283:obj:0: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.
rows.quest:6283:details:0: Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!
rows.quest:6283:details:1: BShe is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.
rows.quest:6283:details:2: BGo back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
rows.quest:6283:completion:0: Already I feel the anger leave me. What will I do with my time? Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. Perhaps this is a good thing... maybe now I can focus on the good, as all Tauren should.
rows.quest:6283:completion:1: BPlease accept this as a reward for your troubles.
rows.quest:6284:obj:0: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6284:details:0: Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.
rows.quest:6284:details:1: BBesseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.
rows.quest:6284:details:2: BMaggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.
rows.quest:6284:completion:0: Good hunting, ⟦26⟧! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.
rows.quest:6284:completion:1: B<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>
rows.quest:6284:completion:2: BPerhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
rows.quest:6301:obj:0: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.
rows.quest:6301:details:0: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.
rows.quest:6301:details:1: B⟦27⟧, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.
rows.quest:6301:details:2: BOnce you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
rows.quest:6301:completion:0: Ah? ⟦28⟧, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and you shall see the power that these seeds will do for the land. Only those pure and true can heal the land?
rows.quest:6381:obj:0: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6381:details:0: As you have seen, ⟦30⟧, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.
rows.quest:6381:details:1: B⟦31⟧, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
rows.quest:6381:completion:0: This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.
rows.quest:6381:completion:1: BOnly then ⟦32⟧, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.
rows.quest:6381:completion:2: BYou have done well ⟦33⟧; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
rows.quest:6393:obj:0: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6393:details:0: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.
rows.quest:6393:details:1: B⟦34⟧, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
rows.quest:6393:completion:0: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. ⟦35⟧, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
rows.quest:6393:completion:1: BFor your efforts, I reward you with a choice of my prized possessions.
rows.quest:6401:obj:0: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.⟦36⟧
rows.quest:6401:details:0: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6401:completion:0: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, ⟦37⟧.
rows.quest:6421:obj:0: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
rows.quest:6421:details:0: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, ⟦38⟧?
rows.quest:6421:details:1: BSoutheast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave. I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.
rows.quest:6421:details:2: BGo young ⟦39⟧, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
rows.quest:6421:completion:0: Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The Kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.
rows.quest:6421:completion:1: BLegend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.
rows.quest:6421:completion:3: BPerhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this Kobold plot.
